verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in AI agent platform with `local-ai chat`, an in-shell agent that reads files, runs commands, and connects to MCP tools behind an approval gate, plus a web UI for configuring agents. This is first-party documented evidence of a built-in assistant capable of task delegation, though it lacks independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent verification of agent behavior, more detail on task complexity/reliability.
